item.text: Company values are joined with commas without CSV quoting. Contact names stay in one column because their commas are replaced with semicolons, which conflicts with the README’s requirement to preserve customer text. I’ll use standard CSV escaping for every field and keep the existing formula protection.

Fixed CRM-284 with standard CSV escaping. Companies like `Acme, Inc` and names like `Doe, Jane` retain their contents within four columns. Quotes and line breaks are escaped correctly, and spreadsheet formula protection remains intact.

All 5 tests pass with `node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/export.test.ts`.
